_comment: Static reference for tools/expo/build.py (exposure dashboard). Per stock: n = display name, s = GICS sector letter, c = country (Hebrew), th = theme tags, yf = Yahoo symbol when it differs, snap = the values of the 12.11.2026 snapshot, used only until the nightly job has fresh data. Per ETF: metadata, the decomposition method (m) and snapshot holdings (h) used when a fetch fails. Edit th here to retag a stock; new S&P 500 members get E->oil_gas, S/U->defensive automatically.
